simple.meaning: רֵבֶץ (rêbets) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a couch or place of repose.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Proverbs 24:15. The surrounding context includes flock, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֵבֶץ (H7258) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: רֵבֶץ (rêbets) / H7258 is traced through Proverbs 24:15, Isaiah 35:7, Isaiah 65:10, Jeremiah 50:6 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a couch or place of repose
definitions.usage: where each lay, lie down in, resting place.
definitions.full: H7258. rebets רֵ֫בֶץ noun [masculine] (place of) lying down, resting- or dwelling-place ; — construct ׳ר בָּקָר Isa 65:10 (|| צאֹן נְוֵה ); suffix רִבְצָהּ תַנִּים בִּנְוֵה 35:7 (compare Ges § 145m , but Du רָֽבְצָה , that is, flock); רִבְצָם Jer 50:6 (people as sheep); of man, רִבְצוֺ Prov 24:15 (|| צַדְּיק נְוֵה ).

occurrences.englishText: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous.
The burning sand will become a pool,
Sharon will be a fold of flocks,
My people have been lost sheep.
